name: Holiday Leftover Roasted Turkey, Jellied Cranberry & Sourdough Sandwich ("The Moist Maker")
whyItWorks: Sliced leftover turkey breast, a thin ribbon of seedless jellied cranberry sauce, and soft white-bread stuffing on toasted sourdough is a top-tier day-after-Thanksgiving meal with minimal fat and zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer sliced white-meat turkey breast, smooth canned jellied cranberry sauce (not whole-berry orange relish), and a spoonful of plain herb stuffing or light mayo between lightly toasted sourdough slices.
watchOuts: Use canned seedless jellied cranberry sauce only—never use homemade orange-zest whole-berry cranberry relish (citrus + skin triggers)
